name: Kaku Konami
source: [url=/c14220]Sango's[/url] classmate and friend. They came to the island together in order to find a part-time job. She takes her work seriously and is very focused, but she is a shy girl and finds it difficult to talk to other people. Sometimes she spaces out and gazes into a distance but doesn't reject human contact. Has little self-confidence, and sometimes imagines everything as negative, but she gets her motivation from Sango and they have a very reassuring relationship.
